result.title: Improving Semantic Coverage in AI Test & Evaluation through Generative Augmentation
result.comment: 21 pages total, previously published at Society of Photo-Optical Instrumentation Engineers (SPIE) Conference Series, Volume 14046
result.summary: In test and evaluation (T&E) of AI models, evaluators typically have access only to a held-out test dataset and no knowledge of the training data or its semantic composition. If critical input conditions---such as time-of-day, weather, or scene location---are underrepresented in this test dataset, T&E results can be misleadingly due to this semantic coverage gap. We propose a three-stage generative AI pipeline to detect and fill such semantic gaps without requiring ground-truth labels of these semantics. First, vision-language models (VLMs) perform zero-shot binary labeling of semantic factors, and an embedding-space clustering step identifies which semantics most affect downstream model behavior. Second, diffusion-based image-to-image models transform existing covered images into the underrepresented semantic domain, preserving scene content while augmenting high-level appearance. Third, statistical analysis of the augmented image embeddings verifies that the synthetic imagery improves dataset coverage before it is incorporated. Crucially, the synthetic data is used only to enrich the test set and no model retraining is performed for T&E. We validate the full pipeline on both image classification and object detection under day/night semantic gaps, showing that the augmented test datasets better distinguish models with and without exposure to the missing semantic, thereby yielding T&E conclusions that more closely match those of an ideal, fully covered dataset. Code available at https://github.com/Hashe037/DEDUCE

AI.brief_summary: 提出三阶段生成式流水线用于 AI 测试评估：先用 VLM 零样本标注语义因子并以嵌入聚类定位最影响模型行为的语义，再用扩散 image-to-image 把已有图像改写进欠表示语义域，最后用嵌入统计校验覆盖率；只扩充测试集、不重训模型。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「嵌入聚类定位影响行为的语义」与「扩散改写保持场景内容、只改高层外观」可能为 LVR 的视觉证据筛选与内容—外观解耦探针构造提供方法线索，可供核查；但对象是分类/检测的评测集，与推理期 latent 状态无直接关系。
